sections.movies: Search TMDb, add and monitor movies, grab releases and import them into your library with hardlinks.
sections.series: Follow series, seasons and episodes, including season packs, anime numbering and daily shows.
sections.music: Follow artists and albums from MusicBrainz and import releases with their tags and covers.
sections.requests: Users ask for movies, series and albums; administrators approve them or let them through automatically.
sections.activity: The download queue, history and a timeline per title explaining why something did or did not arrive.
sections.calendar: Upcoming episodes and releases, on the web and as an iCal feed.
sections.wanted: Missing titles and titles below their quality cutoff, with one-click searches.
sections.downloaders: qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, rTorrent, aria2, SABnzbd and NZBGet.
